items.t: Asana Likely To Report Higher Q3 Revenue; These Most Accurate Analysts Revise Forecasts Ahead Of Earnings Call
items.sum: Asana will report Q3 results Dec. 1, with analysts expecting 8¢ EPS and $218.12M revenue; analyst ratings remain mixed.
